Admission 05-10-2026 is Day-10 so would be excluded as illness, but fracture distal radius following RTA with emergency ORIF falls squarely in the 'except accident' exception. Intimation in 6 hours complies with clause 5.1 24-hour emergency rule and corroborates accident/emergency. Insurer can only deny under 4.1 with CRC approval citing specific clause; denial solely for missing FIR when MLC + ER + discharge summary prove accident would violate 4.1. Fix by filing accident proof now.
